title: CONNECT-IP Operational and Registry Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP operational, congestion-control, DSCP, security, HTTP/1.x intermediary, ICMP sharing, and MASQUE URI suffix registry policy helpers.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpOperationalPolicy` centralizes RFC 9484 guidance for configuration capsule types, burstiness, batching, DATAGRAM-only congestion-control disablement, HTTP/3 and QUIC DATAGRAM preference, QUIC DATAGRAM size limits and oversized-packet handling, ECN and DSCP behavior, authentication and address-assignment privacy, BCP 38 source-spoofing prevention, shared external-address ICMP forwarding, HTTP/1.x opportunistic-send and capsule-forwarding gates, and MASQUE URI suffix registry validation and expert-review approval.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is stateless. Operators and adapters provide deployment configuration, authentication state, congestion-control state, DSCP equivalence decisions, and registry inputs.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Outer ECN signaling is suppressed and packets are marked Not-ECT when congestion control is disabled.
Inner DSCP values are not copied under outer congestion control and coalescing requires equivalent markings.
MASQUE URI suffix path segments must be token-only and distinct.
risks: This policy surface records local decisions and validation helpers; production enforcement still belongs in the HTTP adapter and deployment configuration.
